## PRECC v0.3.108

### Compression routing: prefer lean-ctx over nushell in the cold-start fallback
Ground-truth measurement showed lean-ctx output compression is strongly
net-positive (~+49% on measured commands) while nushell is weak-to-negative
(−20% to −30% net on some command classes). The static/cold-start fallback was
trying **nushell first**, so the weaker backend preempted lean-ctx for every
command it could handle — dragging the default path net-negative on installs
that have no per-class measurements yet (the adaptive net-loss guard only
governs the learned pick, not this fallback).

Fallback reordered to lean-ctx → nushell → lowfat → compression-prompt → rtk.
Verbose commands (grep/find/ls/…) now route to lean-ctx instead of nushell.
Carries the v0.3.107 Windows console-window fix for anyone not yet on it.
